text:
morgan: quick question — for the v2 rollout can we show a lightweight console affordance when requests are routed to a v1-compatible fallback? want UX + telemetry plan.
elaine: agree we need something, but keep it small. a banner per-tenant is fine, not per-request.
sam: telemetry wise we should emit a `fallback.count` with tags: tenant_id, fallback_reason, model_variant. sample traces at 1% initially. also record `fallback.latency_delta` for perf impact.
jia: +1 on tenant-level banner. we must be careful about p95 noise — only show banner if fallback.rate > 0.5% over 5m window. otherwise keep it in the console insights tab.
alex: lifecycle question — do we let tenants opt out of the banner? some customers will want silence. maybe a console toggle "Show compatibility fallback warnings" default ON for new tenants, opt-out for existing.
morgan: good call. UX: short banner text: "Requests are being served by a v1-compatible fallback (impact: latency/cost). See details." small link to docs. not a modal or interruption.
elaine: For rollout we should A/B test: 10% orgs see banner + telemetry enabled, 90% only telemetry. measure alert noise and support tickets.
sam: config sketch for sampling/metrics (example):
```json
{
  "fallback_metrics": {
    "enabled": true,
    "emit_rate": 1.0,
    "trace_sample_fraction": 0.01,
    "per_tenant_aggregation_window_seconds": 300
  }
}
```
jia: recommend we store aggregated counters keyed by (tenant_id, model_name, fallback_variant, region). avoid any full request payload in logs. redact tokens.
console-bot: deploybot: canary deploy queued — v2-fallback-banner@canary scheduled for 1727215000.
alex: regarding quotas — if fallback happens because of capacity, we should show quota delta info: "you are on dedicated capacity X, fallback to lower tier; see suggestions". but avoid exposing exact backend hosts.
morgan: agree. also add trace tag `compat_fallback=true` to traces so APM can correlate errors.
sam: two telemetry signals to surface in console insights: 1) fallback_rate (per-tenant, 5m) 2) fallback_error_rate (if fallback caused model mismatch). both as timeseries with alert thresholds.
jia: on retention — keep aggregated fallback metrics for 90 days, traces for 7 days by default. we can offer extended retention as an addon.
elaine: operational runbook note: if fallback_rate spikes > 5% tenant-wide, auto-create an incident ticket and ping #eng-oncall and the tenant's CSM.
morgan: can someone mock a tiny banner and console insights panel? alex/jia? ideally a screenshot link.
alex: I'll toss a mock in Figma and post link tomorrow.
jia: I'll draft telemetry spec in the repo: services/telemetry/specs/fallback_metrics.md and add unit tests for aggregation logic.
sam: also add a small CLI check for tenants to query their fallback rate: `redwood admin metrics --tenant=xyz --metric=fallback_rate --window=5m`.
elaine: finalize decision by Friday EOD? PMs need text for release notes.
morgan: yep — aim for Friday. thanks all. :thumbsup:
